# Metrics catalog

<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- metrics-catalog` from
     engine/crates/telemetry/src/metrics/instruments.rs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Contract for OBS-005. Names are lower_snake_case with unit suffixes; labels come from
bounded values of the allow-list (reviewer_type, model, provider, task, tier, queue, outcome, stage, language, severity, category, state, kind, reason, pattern, op, policy).
Identifiers (organization, repository, run, commit, path) are never labels; per-tenant
breakdowns come from traces and logs. A label value outside its domain is recorded as `other`.
Duration histogram buckets (seconds): 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10, 30, 60, 120, 300, 900.

| Metric | Type | Unit | Labels | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `review_duration_seconds` | histogram | s | outcome | Wall time of one review run |
| `incremental_index_duration_seconds` | histogram | s | language | Wall time of an incremental graph update |

## Rate formulas

Over a trailing 7-day window of published findings with any feedback:

- `finding_acceptance_rate = (useful + already_handled) / published_with_feedback`
- `finding_false_positive_rate = false_positive / published_with_feedback`

## Span names

`webhook_received, repository_checkout, repository_index, incremental_graph_update, diff_analysis, symbol_mapping, impact_analysis, context_selection, qdrant_search, reviewer_execution, model_request, candidate_generated, finding_verification, deduplication, publication`.
